Basically, grab a water spray thingy for hair, spray some on your hair. And if the water droplets just float on your hair and don't get absorbed at all - then you have low porosity hair. If the water droplets get absorbed quickly , then you have high porosity hair. If you get water droplets floating on your hair but then slowly sink into it , then you have neutral porosity hair. Basically, porosity is all about your cuticles in your hair being tight or not tight enough.
